lines.japanese: よし、読むのをやめちゃうぞ。
lines.english: All right, then. I'm done reading.

lines.japanese: というわけで俺は、重たいファイルを掴んでよっこらせと腰を上げました。
lines.english: And with that, I grabbed the heavy binder and hauled myself to my feet with a heave-ho.

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、ちょっと千歳君！？　君それ、どこさ持ってぐん？」
lines.english: “H-hold it, Shusuke! Where d'you think you're taking that?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、いや、意味ないなら棚に戻しちゃおうと思って」
lines.english: “Oh, well, if there's no point, I thought I'd put it back on the shelf.”

lines.japanese: 「なんで。まずいでしょそれは」
「は？　だって読まなくてもバレないんでしょ？」
lines.english: “Huh? You said nobody would know if I didn't read it.”

lines.japanese: 「バレはしないけど、まずいだろそれは」
lines.english: “Nobody would know, but you still can't put it away.”

lines.japanese: 「えええ？　ちょっと、なんすかそれ。二人とも、さっきと言ってること違わないすか？」
lines.english: “What? Hold on. Didn't you two just tell me the exact opposite?”

lines.japanese: 「だって。たまひよに言われたんなら、ねえ？」
lines.english: “Well, if Tama-chick told you to, then... you know?”

lines.japanese: 「うん。そうだよ、ひよちゃんに言われたんなら、ズルしないでちゃんと読まなきゃ」
lines.english: “Right. If Hiyo told you to read it, then you've got to read it properly. No cheating.”

lines.japanese: いったい何者なんでしょう、俺の担当教官は。
lines.english: Just what kind of person was my instructor, anyway?

lines.japanese: 「他のやつが読めって言ったんなら単なるシゴキくさいけど、あいつが言ったんならソレはたぶんガチ。あいつ、本気でマニュアルが役に立つとか思ってるから。まさにタマイズム」
lines.english: “If someone else told you to read it, it'd probably be hazing. But from her? She means it. She honestly thinks the manual will help you. Pure Tamaism.”

lines.japanese: 「うん。いま思いだしたけど、ひよちゃん、自分でもそれ読破してたさ。まさにタマイズム」
lines.english: “Right. Come to think of it, Hiyo read the whole thing herself. Pure Tamaism.”

lines.japanese: 「……ま、まじっすか。どんだけタマイズム溢れてんすか、あのひと」
lines.english: “...S-seriously? How much Tamaism can one woman contain?”

lines.japanese: やむなく俺は、ファイルを置いて力なく腰を落としました。
lines.english: Defeated, I put the binder down and sank back into my seat.

lines.japanese: でもまあ、読むのは大変だけど、彼女に悪意がないと分かっただけでも良しとしましょう。
lines.english: Still, however miserable the reading might be, at least I knew she hadn't done it out of spite. That counted for something.
